assessment: Using publicly available genetic data, Li and colleagues tested the association and inferred the causality of genetic variants predicted to alter the levels of testosterone, estrogen, SHBG, or IGF-1, against susceptibility, severity and outcome of SARS-Cov2 infection. The main strength of the study is the large cohort which adds to the robustness of the data.
